sources.label: Wikidata · multilingual names and Wikipedia links
sources.license: Wikidata structured data CC0; linked Wikipedia pages have their own licenses
sources.purpose: Identity verified against the complete InChIKey. Language labels are not geographic observations.

sources.label: Europe PMC · literature metadata
sources.license: Europe PMC service terms; article-specific rights retained; metadata only
sources.purpose: Bibliographic discovery and source-reported hit counts. These counts are not SERP Ni or harm measurements.

sources.label: arXiv · new preprints
sources.license: arXiv API terms; per-paper full-text licenses apply separately
sources.purpose: Daily metadata discovery. A preprint or keyword match is not evidence that its claims are reproducible.
